title: Ask before you build
principle: Ask people what they do before you build.

screens.text: Meena wants to sell tiffins. She has not asked anyone yet.

screens.title: Ask first
screens.text: Ask people what they eat today, and what they pay for it.

options.label: Ask ten office workers what they eat now

screens.why: Asking costs nothing. Cooking for nobody costs a lot.

summary: Ask what people do now before you build.

cards.front: Before you build, what do you ask?
cards.back: What they do now: it shows the real need.
